The page is two components: `Page.tsx` lays out the header and `Plans.tsx` draws the cards.

Three things to change:

- give each card a `key`, the linter fails on it
- move the price into a `PriceTag` component
  - so the yearly toggle can reuse it
- stop hard-coding the plan names

The card list could look like this:

```tsx
export function Plans({ plans }: { plans: Plan[] }) {
  return (
    <section className="plans">
      {plans.map((plan) => <PlanCard key={plan.id} plan={plan} />)}
    </section>
  )
}
```

And the check that guards it:

```
pnpm lint && pnpm test
```

Which plans change:

| Plan | Price | Notes |
|:---|---:|---|
| **Free** | $0 | One project, community support, and the yearly toggle does not apply to it at all. |
| **Team** | $12 | Per seat, with a `PriceTag` that reads the yearly discount from the plan. |
| **Business** | $29 | Per seat; SSO and audit logs, which the pricing page links to in [the docs](https://example.com/docs). |

> The yearly toggle is the part most likely to break:
> it changes the price and the label together.

Next steps:

1. Add the `key` to each card
2. Move the price into `PriceTag`
3. Read the plan names from the data

---

I can start with the first one.

The design is in the [Pricing page spec](https://www.notion.so/ashulab/Pricing-page-spec-3f2a9c), and the first draft is in https://github.com/AshuLab/web/pull/412/files#diff-3f2a9c71.
